rust_summary: reading and setting the world border (`native_world_border`, `native_set_world_border`).
doc_summary: On the authoritative server tick, `native_world_border(dimension)` returns the border's centre, size, target size and the ticks left of a move, and `native_set_world_border(dimension, center, size, lerp)` sets the centre and either the size at once or, with `lerp` `(target, ticks)`, a move from `size` to `target` over `ticks` server ticks (`WorldBorder.lerpSizeBetween`). Horizon keeps one border for the whole server, so every dimension names the same one. Vanilla's limits apply (sizes 1 to 59999968, centres within 29999984) and nothing changes on an error. Players are told through vanilla's border packets at the end of the tick; mods listening to border changes are not. Each helper is limited to 512 calls per mod per tick. Bundles need fragment @API:world_border_state@.
